description: Explicit settings-variance evidence claims. The inventory generator derives every registered option from PrintConfigDef and marks all other options uncovered.
default_uncovered_reason: No dedicated settings-variance evidence is declared for this registered option; full_print_config() construction, schema serialization, and source coverage do not establish behavior.

sparse_infill_pattern.reason: Every registered sparse pattern is deserialized and required to emit sparse-role geometry; rectilinear and gyroid are also exercised with both wall generators as a bounded interaction pair.

top_surface_pattern.reason: Every registered top pattern is deserialized and required to emit top-solid geometry, with monotonic and concentric output compared.

bottom_surface_pattern.reason: Every registered bottom pattern is deserialized and required to emit bottom-surface geometry, with monotonic and concentric output compared.

wall_generator.reason: Classic and Arachne are deserialized, sliced on a ledged fixture, and required to produce distinct perimeter evidence; each is paired with two sparse patterns.

ensure_vertical_shell_thickness.reason: Every registered shell-thickness mode is deserialized and sliced; none and all must produce distinct solid-infill evidence.

seam_position.reason: Every registered seam position is deserialized and sliced. A seeded random-seam fixture must visit multiple sides of rectangular outer walls, normalized against actual emitted extrusion bounds; nearest and random are also compared.

sparse_infill_density.reason: Zero, nominal, and full density are applied to a real slice and checked for absent sparse geometry, sparse geometry, and solid geometry respectively.

wall_loops.reason: Zero, one, and four wall loops are applied to a real slice; perimeter counts and lengths distinguish disabled, nominal, and expanded behavior.

top_shell_layers.reason: Zero, one, and two top-shell layers are applied to a real slice; zero disables top coverage, while extremal solid fill-surface layer counts and areas distinguish one from two.

bottom_shell_layers.reason: Zero, one, and two bottom-shell layers are applied to a real slice; zero disables bottom coverage, while extremal solid fill-surface layer counts and areas distinguish one from two.

layer_height.reason: Direct Slicing contracts check range overrides, contiguous bounded layers, fixed profiles, smoothing, and editing. Full Print exports of a 1.2 mm fixture at 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3 mm check exact layer counts, HEIGHT tags, and extrusion Z values. The minimum-height substitution mutation is caught by the layer-count oracle. Initial-layer height is coupled to nominal height; independent interactions and numeric boundaries remain unclaimed.

initial_layer_print_height.reason: First extrusion Z follows the configured initial height, final extrusion Z stays at the fixed 1.2 mm fixture height, and the larger first layer reduces the finite extrusion-layer count. Representative values only; full numeric ranges and interactions remain unclaimed.

top_shell_thickness.reason: Independently changing top shell thickness changes Internal solid infill length while role presence, layer count, and first/max extrusion Z remain stable. Representative values only; full numeric ranges and interactions remain unclaimed.

bottom_shell_thickness.reason: Independently changing bottom shell thickness changes Internal solid infill length under the same fixed-height and layer/Z invariants. Representative values only; full numeric ranges and interactions remain unclaimed.

top_surface_density.reason: 0% suppresses top-surface extrusion, 40% remains positive, 100% is greater than each sparse case, and bottom role length is unchanged.

bottom_surface_density.reason: 10% and 40% are positive sparse cases, 100% is greater than each, and top role length is unchanged.

gcode_comments.reason: The exporter is run with comments enabled and disabled; the test requires comment text to change while the parsed motion stream remains identical.

layer_change_gcode.reason: Lifecycle hooks are emitted at their intended boundaries; layer hooks resolve each layer index in order. Incremental export matches a fresh export for hook counts and deposited material. Arbitrary template syntax is not claimed. [GCodeBeltApron] additionally counts one expanded layer-change hook per prologue band before the first object layer.

ironing_type.reason: The pipeline comparison covers no ironing and topmost ironing, requiring the latter to emit ironing paths; the top and solid enum values are covered elsewhere but are not claimed here.

ironing_spacing.reason: The test compares zero and sub-minimum spacing with IRONING_SPACING_MIN in emitted ironing paths; it establishes the lower clamp behavior without claiming the full numeric boundary domain.

filament_ironing_spacing.reason: The filament override path is compared at zero and sub-minimum spacing with IRONING_SPACING_MIN in emitted ironing paths; upper and per-filament boundary coverage is not claimed.

solid_infill_rotate_template.reason: Layered solid-fill angle output is checked for a fixed step, a seven-angle list, and a two-layer run modifier; arbitrary template syntax is not claimed exhaustive.

sparse_infill_rotate_template.reason: A seven-angle sparse-fill template is required to repeat in the emitted layer sequence; other template forms and malformed strings are not claimed.

solid_infill_direction.reason: Solid-fill angles at directions zero and thirty degrees are compared layer by layer, establishing the configured offset without claiming angular boundary coverage.

sparse_infill_smooth_factor.reason: Multiple fill families compare unsmoothed and fully smoothed paths using point, turn, and connectivity oracles; intermediate percentages are not claimed exhaustive.

fill_multiline.reason: Multiline fill tests exercise one, two, and three lines and check path connectivity and shape invariants; the complete integer range is not claimed.

separated_infills.reason: The same multi-body fixtures run with separation disabled and enabled, requiring body-local infill matching or the expected shared-origin difference.

tpms_adaptive.reason: Adaptive TPMS tests exercise disabled, lobes, stepped shells, smooth blend, distance warp, and normal-axis modes with density and invariance oracles; normal_y and the full enum domain are not claimed exhaustive.

tpms_interior_density.reason: Adaptive TPMS fixtures use five, twenty-five, and forty percent interior density and compare measured core and shell infill; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

tpms_adaptive_gradient.reason: The adaptive-gradient test runs linear, quadratic, and exponential and checks their measured surface-to-core ordering, covering every registered enum value.

gyroid_optimized.reason: Adaptive gyroid output is generated with optimization disabled and enabled and the complete printed sequence is compared.

infill_direction.reason: The sparse anchor test sets a forty-five-degree direction and matches generated anchors against printed infill; angular boundaries are not claimed.

align_infill_direction_to_model.reason: The sparse anchor matrix runs both model-aligned states, including a rotated instance, and checks the emitted paths against generated anchors.

only_one_wall_top.reason: A three-wall fixture is sliced with the option disabled and enabled; the top-layer perimeter count must decrease when only one wall is allowed.

only_one_wall_first_layer.reason: A three-wall fixture is sliced with the option disabled and enabled; the first-layer perimeter count must decrease when only one wall is allowed.

extra_perimeters_on_overhangs.reason: An overhang fixture is sliced with extra overhang perimeters disabled and enabled; the enabled result must contain more perimeter paths.

overhang_reverse.reason: An overhang fixture is sliced with reversal disabled and enabled; signed external-perimeter winding must change.

is_infill_first.reason: Both ordering states are sliced and the first non-first-layer extrusion role must begin with perimeter or infill accordingly.

spiral_mode.reason: A sloped fixture is sliced with spiral mode disabled and enabled; parsed G-code must show no extruding Z moves versus continuous extruding Z motion.

thick_bridges.reason: A bridge fixture is sliced with thick bridges disabled and enabled; both emit bridge paths and their rounded-versus-normal flow volume per unit path must differ.

enable_arc_fitting.reason: A curved-cylinder fixture is exported with arc fitting disabled and enabled; the G-code must contain zero versus positive G2/G3 moves.

detect_thin_wall.reason: A perpendicular sub-nozzle fin is sliced with thin-wall detection disabled and enabled; the enabled result must add external-perimeter medial-axis paths extending beyond the body edge.

fuzzy_skin_first_layer.reason: External fuzzy skin is sliced with first-layer fuzz disabled and enabled; the emitted perimeter length must change.

hole_to_polyhole.reason: A circular through-hole fixture is sliced with conversion disabled and enabled; the resulting hole vertex count must differ.

hole_to_polyhole_twisted.reason: A converted hole is sliced with twisted conversion disabled and enabled; the first-hole checksum must change.

brim_flow_ratio.reason: Ratios 0, 0.5, 1, and 2 cover both registered boundaries and scale parsed brim extrusion while preserving brim geometry and object extrusion. A separate first-layer ratio of 0.6 scales first-layer object extrusion while leaving brim and later-layer object extrusion unchanged. Other flow-ratio interactions are not claimed.

brim_use_efc_outline.reason: A compensated brim fixture is sliced with EFC outline compensation disabled and enabled; both brims must exist and their outline checksum must differ.

center_of_surface_pattern.reason: The surface-centering regression generates each_surface, each_model, and each_assembly and requires a changed center to alter paths while a reslice matches a fresh slice; it does not claim every enum transition independently.

enable_support.reason: Support-disabled and support-enabled overhang slices are compared and require zero versus positive support points.

support_on_build_plate_only.reason: Both states are sliced on a two-tier fixture and must produce different positive support-point counts.

support_ironing.reason: Support interface layers are sliced with support ironing disabled and enabled; the enabled result must add support-ironing paths.

support_interface_top_layers.reason: Configured top interface counts one, two, three, four, and six are checked against emitted support-interface layers; the full integer range is not claimed.

support_interface_bottom_layers.reason: Bottom interface counts zero, one, three, and six plus the top-count sentinel are checked in emitted support layers; full boundary coverage is not claimed.

support_interface_pattern.reason: Emitted-fill contracts distinguish rectilinear from rectilinear_interlaced by layer orientation and rectilinear from spiralinset by finite interface extrusion, at least three interface layers, and aggregate interface length. The six-mode SupportInterfacePattern test adds public extrusion-path geometry oracles, but its native baseline and routing mutations are pending; complete enum pipeline coverage remains unclaimed until that validation passes. Numeric spacing and other interaction domains remain unclaimed.

support_bottom_interface_spacing.reason: Bottom interface spacing zero and four are compared across support styles and require denser output at zero; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

gcode_flavor.reason: Every registered firmware flavor is deserialized and exercised in relative and absolute E modes with analytic path and deposited-filament totals, parsed temperature/tool commands, and fan PWM endpoints and midpoint.

use_relative_e_distances.reason: Both relative and absolute extrusion modes are exported and parsed, requiring M83 versus M82 and equal positive deposited material and XY path length.

nozzle_temperature_initial_layer.reason: The exporter sets an initial-layer temperature of 211 and requires that value in emitted thermal commands; the integer range is not claimed.

nozzle_temperature.reason: The exporter sets a regular nozzle temperature of 203 and requires that value in emitted thermal commands; the integer range is not claimed.

initial_layer_fan_speed.reason: The exporter sets initial-layer fan speed zero and requires an emitted fan-off command; the full percent domain is not claimed. [GCodeBeltApron] additionally requires the 37 percent override before the first object layer, parsed from executable fan PWM commands.

full_fan_speed_layer.reason: The exporter sets the full-speed transition at layer two and requires full-speed fan output; other transition counts are not claimed.

close_fan_the_first_x_layers.reason: The cooling pipeline holds the fan off for five configured initial layers and requires an explicit M106 S0 command; boundary counts are not claimed.

fan_min_speed.reason: The multifilament cooling matrix varies minimum fan speeds by extruder variant and requires the corresponding emitted PWM percentages; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

fan_max_speed.reason: The multifilament cooling matrix varies maximum fan speeds by extruder variant and requires the corresponding emitted PWM percentages; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

emit_machine_limits_to_gcode.reason: Both boolean values are sliced with Marlin2: enabling emits executable M201/M203/M204/M205 commands and preserves deposited material.

machine_max_acceleration_extruding.reason: Single- and multi-extruder machine-envelope tests set extruding acceleration values and require the selected maximum in M204 output; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_acceleration_retracting.reason: Single- and multi-extruder machine-envelope tests set retracting acceleration values and require the selected maximum in M204 output; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_acceleration_travel.reason: Single- and multi-extruder machine-envelope tests set travel acceleration values and require the selected maximum in M204 output; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_junction_deviation.reason: Machine-envelope tests set junction deviation values and require their selected maximum in M205 J output; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

accel_to_decel_factor.reason: Direct Klipper output resolves factor 50 from acceleration 1600 to ACCEL_TO_DECEL=800. Representative values only; full numeric ranges and interactions are not claimed.

brim_type.reason: No-brim and outer-brim configurations are distinguished by printed mass and center-of-mass output; the complete brim enum domain is not claimed.

brim_width.reason: A 5 mm outer-brim width reaches a mass and center-of-mass oracle; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

enable_overhang_bridge_fan.reason: An enabled overhang-bridge-fan configuration reaches the cooling export and its emitted fan evidence; the disabled state is not independently claimed.

enable_overhang_speed.reason: Both overhang-speed states are exercised by cooling fixtures and checked through emitted speed behavior; interactions with every overhang mode are not claimed.

enforce_support_layers.reason: The support contract compares enforcement at 0 and 100 and requires absent versus nonempty support on the same overhang fixture; the declared 0..5000 numeric range is not exhausted.

exposure_time.reason: The SLA validation contract accepts a 2.0 second exposure and rejects 6.0 seconds when the configured maximum is 5.0 seconds. This is one coupled validation case, not the complete exposure boundary domain.

filament_density.reason: Two extruder density values produce the measured mass ratio and center-of-mass shift; density boundaries are not claimed.

hollowing_enable.reason: The enabled SLA hollowing path produces a nonempty interior mesh with smaller absolute volume than the solid. The test stops at the hollowing stage because the production drill_holes stage is disabled; disabled-mode interior behavior is not independently asserted.

initial_layer_height.reason: The SLA layer-count comparison runs 1.0 and 0.5 mm initial heights together with matching layer heights and preserves model volume. It does not isolate initial-layer behavior or claim numeric boundaries.

machine_max_acceleration_e.reason: Single and multi-extruder machine-envelope exports check the E acceleration value in M201; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_acceleration_x.reason: Single and multi-extruder machine-envelope exports check the X acceleration value in M201; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_acceleration_y.reason: Single and multi-extruder machine-envelope exports check the Y acceleration value in M201; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_acceleration_z.reason: Single and multi-extruder machine-envelope exports check the Z acceleration value in M201; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_jerk_e.reason: Single and multi-extruder machine-envelope exports check the E jerk value in M205; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_jerk_x.reason: Single and multi-extruder machine-envelope exports check the X jerk value in M205; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_jerk_y.reason: Single and multi-extruder machine-envelope exports check the Y jerk value in M205; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_jerk_z.reason: Single and multi-extruder machine-envelope exports check the Z jerk value in M205; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_speed_e.reason: Single and multi-extruder machine-envelope exports check the E speed value in M203; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_speed_x.reason: Single and multi-extruder machine-envelope exports check the X speed value in M203; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_speed_y.reason: Single and multi-extruder machine-envelope exports check the Y speed value in M203; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

machine_max_speed_z.reason: Single and multi-extruder machine-envelope exports check the Z speed value in M203; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

max_exposure_time.reason: The SLA validation contract lowers the maximum exposure from its fixture default to 5.0 seconds and observes rejection of a coupled 6.0 second exposure. It does not claim standalone maximum-bound behavior.

max_layer_height.reason: The direct nozzle-bound contract checks the zero sentinel's 0.75-nozzle default and an explicit 0.3 mm maximum, including the minimum clamp. It does not claim all numeric boundaries or a full Print pipeline.

min_layer_height.reason: The direct nozzle-bound contract checks configured 0.1 and 0.35 mm minimums and verifies they are returned for the corresponding extruders. It does not exercise numeric boundaries or a full Print pipeline.

nozzle_diameter.reason: The direct nozzle-bound contract uses two configured diameters, 0.4 and 0.6 mm, to derive the corresponding layer-height limits. It does not exercise nozzle-diameter boundaries or a full Print pipeline.

overhang_fan_speed.reason: A 100 percent overhang fan speed reaches emitted cooling output; the numeric speed range is not claimed.

overhang_fan_threshold.reason: The configured overhang threshold is exercised through cooling output on the overhang fixture; other threshold values are not claimed.

pad_enable.reason: The enabled SLA pad path produces nonempty positive-volume pad geometry and support slices. Disabled pad geometry is not independently asserted.

printer_technology.reason: The SLA pipeline contracts select the SLA technology and require successful SLAPrint processing with valid slices and statistics. The FFF/SLA enum transition and other technology values are not independently exercised.

raft_layers.reason: Support-material tests exercise zero and three raft layers through emitted support geometry and layer-count or placement oracles; the numeric range and interactions with every support mode remain unclaimed.

support_base_pattern_spacing.reason: A configured 2.5 mm base spacing is compared against dense bottom-interface output; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

support_line_width.reason: A concrete support line-width value reaches emitted support geometry and role-specific checks; the numeric domain is not claimed.

support_style.reason: Support-style contracts cover all seven registered styles with role-specific base/interface and layer-count oracles.

support_threshold_angle.reason: A 30 degree support threshold is exercised on overhang fixtures with emitted support evidence; angle boundaries are not claimed.

support_type.reason: The normal(auto) and tree(auto) retain the existing emitted-interface contracts, while the manual-support contract exercises normal(manual) and tree(manual) with and without an overlapping support enforcer, requiring zero support without the enforcer and positive support with it. Broader manual-volume geometry remains unclaimed.

supports_enable.reason: The enabled SLA support path consumes a manual support point and produces elevated geometry, a positive-volume support mesh, and support slices. The disabled pipeline separately checks empty support slices; broader support configuration interactions remain untested.

tree_support_branch_angle.reason: Tree support generation uses a 40 degree branch angle and checks generated support geometry; angle boundaries are not claimed.

tree_support_branch_diameter.reason: Tree support generation uses a 1.0 mm branch diameter and checks generated support geometry; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

tree_support_branch_distance.reason: Tree support generation uses a 5.0 mm branch distance and checks generated support geometry; numeric boundaries are not claimed.

z_hop.reason: Zero and a 1 mm Z-hop are sliced with retraction enabled; hopping adds vertical travel moves while preserving deposited material. The full numeric domain and disabled-retraction interaction are not claimed.

line_width.reason: Automatic, layer-height-equal, nominal, and oversized widths exercise validation; outer width also has absolute and percent partitions. These tests call Print::validate; a complete sliced-output matrix is not claimed.

inner_wall_line_width.reason: Automatic, layer-height-equal, nominal, and oversized widths exercise validation; outer width also has absolute and percent partitions. These tests call Print::validate; a complete sliced-output matrix is not claimed. Separate representative fresh/incremental slicing evidence for 0.42 and 0.60 mm inner-wall geometry/filament is in tests/fff_print/test_motion_flow_variance.cpp [MotionFlowVariance]; this entry retains its narrower validation declaration.

tree_support_tip_diameter.reason: Organic support dimensions are varied below the extrusion width, below twice that width, below the tip, and at a legal nominal pair; errors identify the responsible option. These tests call Print::validate; a complete sliced-output matrix is not claimed.

filament_unloading_speed_start.reason: A configured initial unloading speed of 55 mm/s produces a parsed 3300 mm/min feedrate in the direct unload path. Numeric boundaries remain unclaimed.

high_current_on_filament_swap.reason: An enabled high-current fixture emits the M907 E550 command during direct SEMM loading. The disabled command behavior is not independently asserted.

internal_solid_infill_pattern.reason: All nine registered patterns run on a stepped solid; each non-default pattern changes the role/path snapshot and incremental slicing matches a fresh slice before restoration.

top_surface_fill_order.reason: Default, inward, and outward top concentric fill orders produce observable path-order variants, with fresh/incremental/restored equivalence.

bottom_surface_fill_order.reason: Default, inward, and outward bottom concentric fill orders run in both reslice directions; an explicit inward/outward comparison exposes ordering while the default/outward no-effect row remains a negative control.

wall_direction.reason: Both wall directions are checked against absolute contour winding on every generated perimeter loop; clockwise reverses every counter-clockwise loop.

dont_filter_internal_bridges.reason: Disabled, limited, and no-filter internal bridge modes have observable role/path differences on a stepped solid, checked through fresh, incremental, and restored slices.

enable_extra_bridge_layer.reason: All four modes are exercised; an external-overhang fixture activates external-only behavior while the stepped fixture exposes internal-only and apply-to-all changes.

detect_narrow_internal_solid_infill.reason: Both values run in fresh/incremental/restored slices; enabling detection must increase solid-infill path count on the selected narrow fixture.

precise_outer_wall.reason: Both values run in fresh/incremental/restored slices; enabling precise outer walls must reduce aggregate path length for the chosen wall configuration.

infill_complete_top.reason: A 3D honeycomb fixture activates both values and requires increased path count when completion is enabled, with fresh/incremental/restored equivalence.

make_overhang_printable.reason: An overhang fixture with an explicit 20-degree threshold activates both values and requires changed geometry plus fresh/incremental/restored equivalence.

precise_z_height.reason: A nonuniform-height mesh activates both values, permits their different layer counts, and requires changed path evidence plus fresh/incremental/restored equivalence.

top_surface_expansion_direction.reason: An activated ledge fixture distinguishes inward from outward expansion and checks fresh/incremental/restored equality; the combined direction is exercised only as a negative control, so complete enum behavior is not claimed.

slicing_mode.reason: An overlapping-volume fixture distinguishes regular from even-odd parity and checks fresh/incremental/restored equality; close-holes is currently only a negative control on a mesh without the needed hole geometry.

fuzzy_skin_point_distance.reason: Direct ripple consumer checks 0.25, 0.5, 1, and 2 mm sampling with exact counts on an analytic perimeter and disabled/subresolution controls. Other noise types and Print pipeline interactions remain unclaimed.
